# Loria Construction LLC

> Family-owned, second-generation masonry and stamped concrete company in East Rochester, NY, owned by Michael and Anthony Loria. Serving Greater Rochester within about 30 miles. Fully insured. Free on-site estimates.

## Services
- Stamped concrete patios, walkways, stoops and pool decks
- Traditional brushed concrete, and brushed concrete with a stamped border
- Driveways, steps and slabs
- Finished garage and pole barn floors
- Masonry: brick, block, stone veneer, retaining walls, foundations and steps
- Tile and showers
- Commercial concrete

## How we build
Excavate and haul away the old surface, lay a crushed-stone base, set a 2 ft x 2 ft rebar grid, and pour 4+ inches of 4,000 PSI concrete with strength additives. Expansion joints along all masonry. Stoops and larger patios are poured in stages.

## Service area
East Rochester, Rochester, Penfield, Fairport, Pittsford, Webster, Brighton, Henrietta, Perinton, Victor, Greece, Irondequoit, Chili, Gates, Ontario and Canandaigua, NY. Larger jobs further out.
